test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 15 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: As per the United Nations Conference on Trade and Development (UNCTAD) Report 2022, India's economic growth is expected to decline from 8.2% in 2021 to ______ in 2022.
solution:
The correct answer is __**5.7%**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India's economic growth is expected to decline to 5.7% in 2022 from 8.2% in 2021, according to the United Nations Conference on Trade and Development (UNCTAD) Report 2022.
 
• India's GDP will further decelerate to 4.7% growth in 2023, as per this report.
 
• The report has cited higher financing costs & weaker public expenditures for this decline in growth.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The United Nations Conference on Trade and Development (UNCTAD) is an intergovernmental organization.
 
• It aims to promote the interests of developing states in world trade.
 
• UNCTAD is part of the United Nations Secretariat dealing with trade, investment, and development issues. 
 
• UNCTAD:
 
 
• Headquarters: Geneva, Switzerland
 
• Founded: 1964
 
• Founder: United Nations General Assembly
 
• Secretary-General: Rebeca Grynspan
